CURRENT QUESTION:
compare 2021 with 2023 for Gaya and Nalanda, percentage-point change in ANC4 completed divided by registered
attempts.response:
```sql
WITH filtered_data AS (
  SELECT
    year,
    district,
    SUM(anc4_completed) AS total_anc4_completed,
    SUM(pregnancies_registered) AS total_pregnancies_registered
  FROM
    anc_visits
  WHERE
    district IN ('Gaya', 'Nalanda') AND
    year IN (2021, 2023) AND
    source = 'synthetic Bihar ANC fixture'
  GROUP BY
    year, district
),
percentage_points AS (
  SELECT
    district,
    year,
    (total_anc4_completed * 100.0 / NULLIF(total_pregnancies_registered, 0)) AS percentage
  FROM
    filtered_data
)
SELECT
  district,
  (MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2023 THEN percentage ELSE 0 END) -
   MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2021 THEN percentage ELSE 0 END)) AS percentage_point_change
FROM
  percentage_points
GROUP BY
  district;
```
